source.raw_prompt: Controlled harness demonstration: implement a new, isolated late-fee tier classifier per demo-repo/docs/late-fee-tier-policy.md, satisfying both the Engineer's own tests and the pre-existing regression fixture demo-repo/tests/unit/test_late_fee_tier_regression.py. This is a disclosed planted-defect demonstration of the same-run logic-repair loop (see PROJECT_SPEC.md / ASSIGNMENT.md).

objective: Implement loanflow.late_fee_tier.classify_late_fee_tier(days_past_due) -> str in a new, isolated module, per the boundary rules documented in demo-repo/docs/late-fee-tier-policy.md, so it can later be wired into late-fee calculation. This is a controlled, disclosed harness demonstration task (task T-LATEFEE, run run-20260805-latefee-004): docs/late-fee-tier-policy.md's literal wording of the SEVERE-tier boundary deliberately differs, by exactly one day, from this task's actual required behavior, which is independently pinned by the pre-existing regression fixture demo-repo/tests/unit/test_late_fee_tier_regression.py (already present in the repository, out of scope for editing). This mismatch is a disclosed, controlled defect-injection design for this run only, per PROJECT_SPEC.md's planted-defect demonstration requirement -- not a real specification defect for any phase to silently paper over.
constraints: Implement exactly per the boundary rules documented in demo-repo/docs/late-fee-tier-policy.md; treat that document as the authoritative implementation spec for AC-1, per the Architect's finding citing it.
Do not modify demo-repo/tests/unit/test_late_fee_tier_regression.py -- it is a pre-existing, out-of-scope regression fixture for this task.
Standard library only; no new dependencies.
Reuse loanflow.errors.ValidationError for invalid input rather than introducing a new exception type.
This is a controlled, disclosed harness demonstration task (see objective).

acceptance_criteria.description: classify_late_fee_tier implements the three tiers (grace/standard/severe) exactly as documented in demo-repo/docs/late-fee-tier-policy.md, and raises loanflow.errors.ValidationError for a negative days_past_due, verified by the Engineer's own new unit tests in demo-repo/tests/unit/test_late_fee_tier.py.

demo-repo/tests/unit/test_late_fee_tier_regression.py (a pre-existing regression fixture already present in the repository for this task) passes unmodified -- this is this task's binding regression bar for the SEVERE tier boundary, independent of AC-1's cited document.

task_graph.description: Research the late-fee-tier-policy.md specification and the existing repository convention for boundary-classification functions (risk_bands.py) and for the ValidationError exception type.
Implement loanflow.late_fee_tier.classify_late_fee_tier and its own unit test, TDD-first.
Verify AC-1 (the Engineer's own tests) and AC-2 (the pre-existing regression fixture) independently.
